records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets. Two Wrenfield nudges (email:46e59207, email:0eb274dc) got zero reply, so engagement signal is absent; Starter self-serve accounts with total silence rarely activate unaided in 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Quick follow-up on my earlier note. Nothing's started in Wrenfield yet, so I wanted to make it easy: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about getting your team in. If email is easier, just reply and I'll help from there.

Best,
Priya
